name: spot-insurance-demo
description: Interactive demo of MySo SPoT prediction markets + insurance coverage with a simulated SPoT oracle.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "pnpm --filter api dev" "pnpm --filter web dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter api build && pnpm --filter web build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter api typecheck && pnpm --filter web exec tsc -b
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules api/node_modules web/node_modules api/dist web/dist
